attributes.sql_formula:
(CASE WHEN $request_host IS NULL
                                THEN CASE WHEN $current_domain IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN '/_main_/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || $id
                                    ELSE '/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || $id END
                                ELSE $request_host || CASE WHEN $current_domain IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN '/_main_/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || $id
                                    ELSE '/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || $id END
                             END)

select.where: $task_id=#THIS.id AND $start_ts IS NOT NULL AND $end_ts IS NULL

attributes.sql_formula:
(CASE WHEN $is_error IS TRUE THEN 'error'
                 WHEN $end_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed'
                 WHEN $start_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 'running'
                 ELSE 'waiting'
            END)

CASE
                 WHEN $token IS NULL THEN 'to_activate'
                 WHEN $is_active IS NOT TRUE THEN 'inactive'
                 WHEN $expires_ts IS NOT NULL AND $expires_ts < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'expired'
                 ELSE 'active'
               END

( CASE WHEN $__syscode IS NULL THEN NULL 
                                   ELSE NOT (',' || :env_userTags || ',' LIKE '%%,'|| :systag || ',%%')
                                   END )

CASE WHEN position('\:' in $filepath)>0 THEN '/'||$filepath
             ELSE '/_vol/' || $filepath
            END

( CASE WHEN $__syscode IS NULL THEN NULL 
                                   ELSE NOT (',' || :env_userTags || ',' LIKE '%%,'|| :systag || ',%%')
                                   END )
(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM adm.adm_user_notification AS un WHERE un.user_id=:env_user_id AND un.notification_id=#THIS.id))

CASE WHEN $group_code IS NOT NULL THEN $group_code ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN $group_code IS NOT NULL AND $other_groups IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN $other_groups IS NOT NULL THEN $other_groups ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN ($group_code IS NOT NULL OR $other_groups IS NOT NULL) AND $custom_groups IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN $custom_groups IS NOT NULL THEN $custom_groups ELSE '' END

CASE WHEN $firstname IS NOT NULL AND $lastname IS NOT NULL THEN $firstname||' '||$lastname
                                            WHEN $lastname IS NOT NULL THEN $lastname
                                            ELSE $username END

CASE WHEN $pkgid IS NOT NULL THEN $pkgid
                                               WHEN $tblid IS NOT NULL THEN split_part($tblid,'.',1)
                                               ELSE NULL END

CAST(($tblid IS NOT NULL) AS int)*8+
                                    CAST(($pkgid IS NOT NULL) AS int)*2+
                                    CAST(($username IS NOT NULL) AS int)*4+
                                    CAST(($user_group IS NOT NULL) AS int)*1

attributes.sql_value: COALESCE(:tbl,:pkg,'')||:objtype||:code|| CASE WHEN :private THEN :userid ELSE '' END

attributes.sql_formula:
( CASE WHEN $__syscode IS NULL THEN NULL 
                                   ELSE NOT (',' || :env_userTags || ',' LIKE '%%,'|| :systag || ',%%')
                                   END )
CASE WHEN $n_invoices = 0 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN $n_invoices < 5 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Regular' END
$has_invoices OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invc.invc_invoice_note AS n INNER JOIN invc.invc_invoice AS i ON n.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.customer_id = #THIS.id)
CASE WHEN $total > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN $total > 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END

CASE WHEN $total IS NULL THEN 'Draft'
                                              WHEN $total = 0 THEN 'Empty'
                                              ELSE CASE WHEN $gross_total > 5000 THEN 'Large'
                                                        WHEN $gross_total > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
                                                        ELSE 'Small' END
                                         END

CASE WHEN $total > 1000 THEN :high_label
                                              WHEN $total > 100 THEN :mid_label
                                              ELSE :low_label END

CASE WHEN $inv_number LIKE :pat_a THEN 'Series A'
                                              WHEN $inv_number LIKE :pat_b THEN 'Series B'
                                              ELSE 'Other' END
$date - MOD(CAST(EXTRACT(DOW FROM $date) AS integer) + 6, 7) * INTERVAL '1 day'

select.columns: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE $unit_price IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)

attributes.sql_formula: SELECT CAST(xmlagg(xmlelement(name invc_invoice_notes_xml_xml,xmlforest(note_type,note_text))) AS text) FROM #nestedselect invc_invoice_notes_xml_xml
CASE WHEN $quantity IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Small' WHEN $quantity < 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END

CASE WHEN $effective_price IS NULL THEN 'No price'
                                              WHEN $effective_price > @product_id.unit_price
                                                   THEN 'Above list'
                                              WHEN $effective_price < @product_id.unit_price
                                                   THEN 'Discounted'
                                              ELSE 'At list price' END

array_length(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT ir.product_id
                                                            FROM invc.invc_invoice_row AS ir
                                                            WHERE ir.invoice_id = #THIS.invoice_id), 1)
CAST($year AS TEXT) || ': ' || CAST($unit_price AS TEXT)
CASE WHEN $unit_price > 500 THEN 'Premium' WHEN $unit_price > 100 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'Budget' END
CAST ( (  CAST( (xpath(:calculated_path, CAST($details as XML) ) )[1]  AS text) ) AS numeric)
CAST( (xpath(:calculated_path, CAST($details as XML) ) )[1]  AS text)
CAST ( (  CAST( (xpath(:calculated_path, CAST($details as XML) ) )[1]  AS text) ) AS numeric)
